title: Update bundled Font Awesome Free to the current stable release
source: User asked whether Font Awesome should be updated, then authorized the update while AFK.
scope: Upgrade Free Solid 5.7.2 to stable 7.3.1 using the official desktop OTF; update the matching About logo, source attribution, license notices and asset manifest. Preserve the font-based approach, existing Unicode choices, control sizes and interactions.

upstream.provenance: Downloaded from the official stable release; archive SHA-256 matches GitHub's release-asset digest. All 14 existing codepoints map to Free Solid icons in official 7.3.1 metadata.

implementation: Replace the old TTF with the unmodified official 7.3.1 Free Solid desktop OTF; update production/test resources and retain all 14 codepoints. Only Free Solid is bundled.
Update the matching About brand logo, preserving its blue fill, plus upstream notices, provenance and hashes. Qt notices remain unchanged.
Explicitly use the normal application font for editor text: the new desktop font's ASCII/icon-name ligatures exposed inherited icon-font shaping. Action icons retain their icon font.

Resolve the user-reported cart offset under UI-031 by inheriting symmetric base padding. Move the matching arrival/departure position from height/4 to height/8 so the arrow ends inside the basket. Preserve icon sizes, gesture thresholds and animation timing.

regressions.glyphs: New normal-preset qshopper_iconfont_tests: 17 passing records, testing actual bundled QRawFont family/style, 14 codepoints, nonzero outlines and absence of the old TTF resource.
regressions.editor_before: All three production-editor text-shaping cases fail before the normal-font fix. Icon ligature text measures 62.5 versus expected 194.58 pixels. Report: out/fontawesome/inputfont-before.txt.
regressions.editor_after: Native Windows inputfont test: five passing records. Normal UI entry: 210 passing records. Actual Return preserves exact text and clears the editor. Native Android entry driver: 36 passing checks. Reports: inputfont-after.txt, windows-editor-workflows.txt and android-entry-final/results.json under out/fontawesome.
regressions.cart: UI-031 records failing-before/passing-after actual Windows and Android pixel alignment and final position. All 16 Windows alignment/endpoint cases and ten final native Android arrow profiles pass. Endpoint reports: cart-endpoint-before.txt, cart-endpoint-after.txt, windows-endpoint-regressions.txt and android-endpoint-before/after/results.json under out/fontawesome.

harness_adjustments: Raise only the outer full-UI timeout from 225 to 300 seconds: its original 205 records completed in 219 seconds under the concurrent build/test load. Assertion deadlines stay unchanged; final expanded entry passes 210 records.
License scrollbar helper uses up to three continuous drags from its actual current thumb position while variable-height paragraph estimates settle. Strict endpoint, bounds and data assertions remain.

Software swipe-contrast checks retain body contrast, glyph presence, outline configuration, palettes and actions. Only arrow outline pixel certification is confined to native renderers: matched 19-pixel software rendering differs from native RHI. Native Windows and Android retain the strict 3:1 pixel predicate; no XFAIL/skip markers added.

verification.windows: All 23 normal CTest entries pass across the initial full run and corrected/affected reruns. Initial full-run failures (missing new preset target, outer UI timeout, scrollbar helper and software-only outline measurement) are retained in windows-tests.txt; fixes and passing results are in windows-rerun.txt, windows-final-about.txt, windows-editor-workflows.txt and windows-cart-regressions.txt under out/fontawesome. Final cart rerun passes all four offscreen/native arrow and contrast entries.
verification.android: API 36 isolated emulator: About 26 checks, strict swipe contrast 100 checks, final editor entry 36 checks and final cart feedback ten profiles pass. About/contrast reports predate the final editor-font/cart-position adjustments; the affected entry and arrow scenarios were rerun on the updated APK. Final arrow report: out/fontawesome/android-endpoint-after/results.json. No microphone used, no physical device installed.
verification.packages: Final x86_64 and signed ARM64 debug APKs built. Both payload contracts pass: 53 native libraries, no unwanted QML tooling, test, Canvas or desktop keyboard libraries, and valid isolated QML scan roots. Reports: out/fontawesome/package-x86-final.json and package-arm64-final.json. APK hashes: out/fontawesome/apk-hashes.json.
verification.quality: Qt 6.12 qmlformat and clang-format 22.1.8 checks pass. Python scripts compile. New C++ test translation unit passes configured clang-tidy/Clazy analysis; existing production C++ is unchanged.

limitations: Physical-device acceptance and release readiness are not claimed. Existing QA follow-ups and excluded REL-001 remain unchanged.
